usedFor: FuseDesk holds support cases and contacts, and Google Docs receives text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Case Closed” in FuseDesk, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A closed case can add text to a chosen Docs tab, leaving a written record of what was resolved.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose add to keep earlier text.
